name: Vietnamese Idioms Quiz
description: Learn Vietnamese the fun way! "Vietnamese Idioms Quiz" is a simple and addictive pop-up game that helps you master popular Vietnamese idioms (thành ngữ) and proverbs (tục ngữ) by guessing their meanings in English. With over 50 hand-picked expressions, instant feedback, and automatic new questions, it’s perfect for language learners, overseas Vietnamese, or anyone curious about Vietnamese culture. No ads, no tracking, completely free!
